lore_anchors.definition: A secret society that seeks to spread confusion and chaos, using truth itself as their primary weapon to manipulate others into self-destruction.
A high-ranking leader of the Zuowandao, captured by the Great Liang Imperial Preceptor. His name reflects his role as a gambler who controls outcomes with calculated truths.
The name of a Zuowandao agent embedded within Li Huowang’s group; the name is also the “Red Center” tile from a mahjong set.

In this novel’s context, the Mandate is a stolen fragment of divine power that holds up reality; it can only be supported by a family willing to commit self-slaughter, making it a curse as much as a blessing.
The terrestrial energy channel that determines a dynasty’s stability and legitimacy; severing it is a catastrophic act that leads to cosmic and political collapse.
A powerful weapon used by the Imperial Preceptor, capable of summoning purple lightning; its name implies a direct connection to celestial authority and punishment.
The Imperial Preceptor of the Great Liang Dynasty, a fearsome cultivator tasked with protecting the nation’s supernatural and political stability.
The young, desperate Emperor of Great Liang, whose body houses a hidden parasitic entity placed by the Zuowandao.
Li Huowang’s sworn brother and a scholar with a deep understanding of the Dao-Twisted World’s rules, known for his wisdom, loyalty, and unshakeable moral compass.
